svg.title: Global spectral localization and its categorical projector
svg.desc: On the actual complex spectral quotient, an ample determinant and all rational frame representations give compact generators. The full exterior tensor comparison identifies the localization counit kernel with the diagonal. Its idempotent algebra gives the ordinary spectral projector. Finite atlas descent and the full residue-field unit proof give geometric field-point generators, including generic coefficient extensions. The rank-one diagonal retains its degree-minus-two derived variable. Nilpotent image and regularity remain unproved.
svg.text: Global spectral localization and the categorical projector
Z = [W / GL_b] over C; full DG objects, mapping complexes and coefficient changes.
1. The determinant and all frame representations — GSL.1–GSL.10
L = det RΓ(X_Z, V(ρ)(ℓD_h)); L and the frame module are compact Loc-values.
P_(a,V) = L^(−a) ⊗ E_V, a ≥ 0, every finite rational GL_b-representation V
Finite affine Čech + Reynolds contraction compute full unbounded mapping complexes.
QCoh(Z) = Ind Perf(Z); every P_(a,V) is compact and the family detects zero.
The unit is compact. All representation weights remain necessary.
2. The actual counit kernel is the diagonal — GSL.11–GSL.19
QCoh(Z) ⊗ QCoh(Z)
π ≃
QCoh(Z × Z)
U(M) = ∫ Hom(Loc(T), M) ⊗ T, with the full compact DG category of T.
K_(Loc U) = π((Loc ⊗ Loc)(R_R)) ≃ Δ_*O_Z
Coend evaluation gives the actual path-algebra map, including every higher map.
The diagonal transform is Id: Loc U → Id is an equivalence; U is continuous and fully faithful.
Its R-linear projection comparison and adjunction maps retain the balancing coherences.
3. The ordinary spectral projector — GSL.20–GSL.24
A_sp = U(O_Z), A_sp ⊛ A_sp → A_sp is an equivalence of commutative algebras.
H_Z ≃ M_L ⊗_R QCoh(Z) ≃ Mod_(A_sp)(M_L)
P_Z is free action; J_Z is continuous and fully faithful; Π_sp = J_Z P_Z = A_sp ⋆ (−).
Π_sp² ≃ Π_sp; {P_Z c_i} compactly generates H_Z.
Half-root operator Morita transports the ordinary projector to untwisted Dmod(Bun_G).
4. Geometric field-point generators — GSL.25–GSL.30
O_Z is a Reynolds retract of q_*O_W; a finite affine Čech resolution retains P_Z c_i.
Atlas A = R[t, ξ], |t| = 0, |ξ| = −1, dξ = f(t); its cohomology is bounded.
FE.5 + finite Postnikov layers: A lies in Loc{κ(p)}, for every prime p of H⁰(A).
Choose K_p = algebraic closure of κ(p), and σ_p : Spec K_p → W_I → Z.
Point pushes σ_p*P_(σ_p)c_i generate H_Z; J_(σ_p)P_(σ_p)c_i generate its image.
Generic coefficient fields are included. This concerns points of Z_C.
5. Rank-one diagonal: the negative degrees survive — GSL.31–GSL.38
X = P¹, H = G_m: Z = B G_m × Spec C[ξ], |ξ| = −1.
Diagonal module C[ξ,u,u⁻¹], wt(u) = (−1,1), ξ_1 and ξ_2 both act by ξ.
Semifree resolution: E = (D ⊗ D)[v], |v| = −2, dv = ξ_1 − ξ_2.
At the classical pair: E[u,u⁻¹] ⊗ᴸ_(D⊗D) C = C[u,u⁻¹,v], d = 0.
H^(−2j) = C[u,u⁻¹]v^j, j ≥ 0. Ordinary tensor loses these classes.
The diagonal kernel need not be perfect on the product.
Further geometric claims remain required
Nilpotent singular-support image and regularity; tempered and microlocal comparisons;
spectral construction over arbitrary characteristic-zero geometric ground fields.
